_about: Read-only snapshot of the Notion Hexagon Registry (MPT > Hexagon Registry (Footprints & Risk)), read 2026-11-27 from the saved view "Counted rows (data points only)" (Row Type is not Control, Framework, Feature or Placeholder). Raw Notion text, escapes and all: scripts/export-catalogue.mjs cleans it and applies the publish filter itself. The 7 non-data rows (386, 388, 417, 421, 422, 423, 424) are therefore not in this file. Refresh by re-reading the view; MPC-11493 is still writing Evidence Keys, which this export does not use. Do not edit by hand.

Which kinds of data leaked with the address in each known breach (passwords, phone numbers, dates of birth). Tool: HaveIBeenPwned. Proposed confidence 92/100. Needs the person's consent (MPC-11307).

Whether a password or password hash tied to the address sits in leaked databases. Tool: Dehashed. Proposed confidence 70/100. Never store or show the password or hash; keep only yes/no, count and source name. Needs consent (MPC-11307).
Name, phone, address, IP or username that leaked in the same record as the email. Tool: Dehashed. Proposed confidence 62/100. Needs consent (MPC-11307).
The same username registered on many sites, linking separate accounts into one profile. Tools: Sherlock, WhatsMyName. Proposed confidence 55/100 for a single-tool hit. Needs consent (MPC-11307).

Whether the address is a Google account and what is public on it: account ID, name, photo, Maps reviews and photos, YouTube channel, calendar. Tool: GHunt (needs a signed-in Google session on our side). Proposed confidence 78/100. Needs consent (MPC-11307).

The services where this address already has an account (around 120 sites checked). Tool: Holehe. Proposed confidence 66/100. Raise risk to High if a dating, adult, health or finance site is found. Needs consent (MPC-11307).
